question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

__Although__ he got the message he rushed home.
solution:
The correct answer is **As soon as****.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence can be improved by replacing the **"Although" **with **"As soon as."**
